10/24/2007:  Data Correction (jb): 
 
             - Unknown problem led to several faulty data entries in  
               early September.  Problem seems to have been isolated 
               to the 09/02/07 - 09/10/07 time period.   The following 
               five-minute (and associated hourly and daily) data 
               entries have been removed from both the archived raw 
               data and the MAWN database: 
 
                  09/02/2007 (d=245): 2220 
                  09/03/2007 (d=246): 2015-2020, 2223-2230 
                  09/04/2007 (d=247): 0605, 0910, 0925, 1245 
                  09/08/2007 (d=251): 0410-0415, 0640-0705 
                  09/09/2007 (d=252): 1025-1030, 1125-1130 
                  09/10/2007 (d=253): 0305-0405, 1050-1315 
 
 
04/18/2007:  Telecommunication Trouble Corrected: (sm) 
 
             - Wireless broadband modem was repaired and replaced (09:30) 
 
 
04/10/2007:  Telecommunication Troubles: 
 
             - Wireless broadband modem has failed at the South Haven 
               MAWN station.   The modem has been pulled and now  
               waiting for repair/replacement.   Planning on repairs 
               to be made later next week.
